@luxas thanks for your comment on this! I believe there were still some questions in the discussion by @rosti what the future plans are for this effort. Since this started some time ago and I just carried it over, were there any ideas on how to build upon this patch to serialize multiple YAML files? Can we use this to be used inside a `CodecFactory`, for example?

> @rosti what the future plans are for this effort. Since this started some time ago and I just carried it over, were there any ideas on how to build upon this patch to serialize multiple YAML files? Can we use this to be used inside a CodecFactory, for example?

We still need it, but it's nothing that will be used by an "end-user" of API machinery. Instead, it'll be used internally for higher-level Serializer/CodecFactory-style abstractions that are able to e.g. read a YAML file and directly assess what type it is, **without** marshalling the full type into memory. You can take a look at my ConfigSerializer prototypes in earlier PRs showcasing this: #72883

Just talked about this in kubeadm triage. [(notes,recording)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/130_kiXjG7graFNSnIAgtMS1G8zPDwpkshgfRYS0nggo/edit#heading=h.asr75p301196)
This patch is looking good.

We recall there was some discussion of how generally useful this abstraction is.

Alex did some work to identify how multi-doc is handled in other places such as kubectl, and we found other points of interest in the multiple YAML Unmarshal code-paths that exist across the project.

@obitech, can we dig up that work before we decide to merge this?
I personally think this refactor is still a useful step toward working with multi-doc and ComponentConfig.

I'll schedule this for discussion on the next wg-component-standard call.

> @obitech, can we dig up that work before we decide to merge this?

I've documented some steps here: https://github.com/obitech/k8s-yaml-test
/lgtm

issue_context.title: Add a YAML MetaFactory serialise multi-doc files
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
Add an external MetaFactory that allows for serializing multiple YAML (or JSON) files in kubeadm. The logic of marshalling YAML should be factored out from `cmd/kubeadm/app/util/marshal` to `staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime/serializer/`.

**Why is this needed**:
This will allow processing component configs containing multiple documents per file. Additionally, an out-of-tree library would allow sharing this functionality with other components.
